data.one_liner: iOS/macOS implementation of the local_auth plugin
data.what_it_does: Provides biometric authentication on iOS and macOS, exposing the same APIs as the platform‑agnostic local_auth package.
use_when: need Face ID or Touch ID authentication
building a cross‑platform app that already uses local_auth
strengths: officially endorsed, automatically included when using local_auth
keeps SDK requirements up to date
no extra pubspec entry needed for normal use

alternatives.name: local_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: provides the same functionality across all platforms
